subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class remember/recall/review/edit/forget memory operator facade in the default memory slot now, route this to plugin/ClawHub packages, or wait until the schema/provenance/write/review companion issues converge?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested work defines new user-facing CLI/skill/API surface across durable memory lifecycle semantics and overlaps existing plugin-specific surfaces.

options.title: Keep as Memory MVP design work
options.body: Leave this open until schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget semantics converge, then implement a small active-memory operator facade.

options.title: Route to plugin or ClawHub
options.body: Close core work only if maintainers decide Engram-style packages, Memory Wiki, LanceDB, or another plugin owns this surface and no SDK gap remains.

options.title: Implement in memory-core now
options.body: Add the commands/tools immediately, accepting the risk of duplicating plugin surfaces or locking lifecycle semantics before the companion issues settle.

recommendation.title: Keep as Memory MVP design work
recommendation.body: Leave this open until schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget semantics converge, then implement a small active-memory operator facade.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible current-main history on the default memory-core boundary and can route whether this belongs in core memory, plugin API, or ClawHub.
